$comment: RTUB configuration manifest (task 039). Names only, never values. Status per environment: required | optional | absent (must not be set) | n/a. devProd: match (DEV and PROD should hold the same value) | differ (must not share a value) | any. Placeholders are composed as <LOCAL_|DEV_|PROD_ + placeholder>. Read by scripts/config/audit-*.ps1; documented in docs/configuration-runbook.md.

policies.maps: No API key or secret: Leaflet with OpenStreetMap standard tiles (tile.openstreetmap.org) in the browser, Nominatim (OpenStreetMap) geocoding on the server.
policies.messaging: The messaging tables are preserved for Messaging v2, which will audit and evolve them. No setting may drop or disable them.
policies.storageProvider: Cloudflare R2 (IDrive is historical; IDrive__* settings are dead).

deprecatedPatterns.reason: IDrive is historical: storage is Cloudflare R2 and no code reads IDrive:*. Delete the setting.
Games were removed in task 026; dead setting.
Removed in #226 F17: no code reads it (the members map is always on; no login popup since React track 004; SQLite only; the gallery limit is GalleryMedia__MaxVideoSize). Delete the setting.
MyTuno was removed in task 026; dead setting.
The messaging tables are preserved for Messaging v2; no setting may drop them.

githubEnvironments.name: R2_DB_ENDPOINT
githubEnvironments.notes: DEV refresh: R2 endpoint of the backup bucket.

githubEnvironments.name: R2_DB_READONLY_ACCESS_KEY_ID
githubEnvironments.notes: DEV refresh: read-only token for rtub-db.

githubEnvironments.name: R2_DB_READONLY_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
githubEnvironments.notes: DEV refresh: read-only token for rtub-db.

githubEnvironments.name: DEV_DATABASE_PASSWORD
githubEnvironments.notes: DEV refresh: the password the sanitizer gives every DEV user.

settings.name: ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT
settings.notes: DEV is Staging (behaves like production; there is no appsettings.Staging.json). PROD is Production.

settings.name: ASPNETCORE_URLS
settings.notes: Must agree with WEBSITES_PORT. Locally, launchSettings.json applicationUrl is used.

settings.name: WEBSITES_PORT
settings.notes: Port App Service forwards to; must agree with ASPNETCORE_URLS.

settings.name: ASPNETCORE_FORWARDEDHEADERS_ENABLED
settings.notes: Real client address and scheme behind the Azure front end (rate limits partition on it).

settings.name: WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE
settings.notes: PROD: required, 1 (the deployed zip is mounted read-only; docs/ci-cd-and-azure-environments.md -> Run from package). DEV: optional - intentionally absent on rtub-dev since task 040's audit correction; the audit does not warn either way.

settings.name: ConnectionStrings__SqliteConnection
settings.notes: Local falls back to Data Source=app.db (src/RTUB.Web/app.db): point it at a scratch copy. On Azure it must stay under /home/site/data (the persistent share). Read the live DEV value; never hardcode the DEV file name.

settings.name: AdminUser__Password
settings.notes: Required the first time the app starts on an empty database (Owner account; no default). PROD needs it only while it has no users.

settings.name: AdminUser__Username
settings.notes: Owner account created on an empty database.

settings.name: AdminUser__Email
settings.notes: Owner account created on an empty database.

settings.name: SeedData__SeedFullDataset
settings.notes: Only true/false are accepted (anything else stops startup). true = Owner + the full development member dataset. PROD: unset or false.

settings.name: SeedData__MemberPassword
settings.notes: Required when SeedFullDataset is true. Never set on PROD.

settings.name: DevelopmentDataReset__Enabled
settings.notes: Destructive reset (Development or Staging only). Keep it off on rtub-dev after a refresh; never set it on PROD.

settings.name: DevelopmentDataReset__Password
settings.notes: Required only while DevelopmentDataReset__Enabled is true. Never in a tracked file.

settings.name: Cloudflare__R2__AccountId
settings.notes: Required on DEV/PROD: storage-backed routes answer 500 without it. Locally optional (the same routes answer 500).

settings.name: Cloudflare__R2__AccessKeyId
settings.notes: Required on DEV/PROD: storage-backed routes answer 500 without it. Locally optional (the same routes answer 500). DEV uses its own bucket-scoped token, never PROD's.

settings.name: Cloudflare__R2__SecretAccessKey
settings.notes: Required on DEV/PROD: storage-backed routes answer 500 without it. Locally optional (the same routes answer 500). DEV uses its own bucket-scoped token, never PROD's.

settings.name: Cloudflare__R2__Bucket
settings.notes: The committed default is the production bucket "rtub"; a non-production environment with R2 credentials and this bucket refuses to start (GuardAgainstProductionBucket).

settings.name: Cloudflare__R2__ProductionBucket
settings.notes: Name of the production bucket for the startup guard. Keep the committed value.

settings.name: Cloudflare__R2__PublicUrl
settings.notes: Public origin of the bucket (also added to the CSP). Without it locally, media are blocked by the CSP.

settings.name: Cloudflare__R2__ReferencePublicUrl
settings.notes: DEV only, after a database refresh: production's public URL, so production media resolve read-only. Never on PROD.

settings.name: Cloudflare__R2__Reference__AccountId
settings.notes: DEV only: read-only view of the production bucket (all four or none; use a read-only token). Never on PROD.

settings.name: Cloudflare__R2__Reference__AccessKeyId
settings.notes: DEV only: read-only view of the production bucket (all four or none; use a read-only token). Never on PROD.

settings.name: Cloudflare__R2__Reference__SecretAccessKey
settings.notes: DEV only: read-only view of the production bucket (all four or none; use a read-only token). Never on PROD.

settings.name: Cloudflare__R2__Reference__Bucket
settings.notes: DEV only: read-only view of the production bucket (all four or none; use a read-only token). Never on PROD.

settings.name: EmailSettings__SmtpServer
settings.notes: Required for real outgoing email; absence disables email, not startup.

settings.name: EmailSettings__SmtpPort
settings.notes: Required for real outgoing email; absence disables email, not startup.

settings.name: EmailSettings__EnableSsl
settings.notes: Required for real outgoing email; absence disables email, not startup.

settings.name: EmailSettings__SmtpUsername
settings.notes: Required for real outgoing email; absence disables email, not startup.

settings.name: EmailSettings__SmtpPassword
settings.notes: Required for real outgoing email; absence disables email, not startup. Gmail: an App Password.

settings.name: EmailSettings__SenderEmail
settings.notes: Required for real outgoing email; absence disables email, not startup.

settings.name: EmailSettings__SenderName
settings.notes: Required for real outgoing email; absence disables email, not startup.

settings.name: EmailSettings__RecipientEmail
settings.notes: Recipient of request notifications (production points it at the no-reply sender). Required for real outgoing email; absence disables email, not startup.

settings.name: WebPush__Enabled
settings.notes: Feature flag for non-Owner members (Owners bypass it).

settings.name: WebPush__VapidSubject
settings.notes: Required for push since 038 (/profile shows "not configured" without the three VAPID values). Use one stable key pair per environment: rotating a live pair invalidates every existing subscription.

settings.name: WebPush__VapidPublicKey
settings.notes: Required for push since 038 (/profile shows "not configured" without the three VAPID values). Use one stable key pair per environment: rotating a live pair invalidates every existing subscription. Generate with scripts/config/generate-vapid-keys.ps1.

settings.name: WebPush__VapidPrivateKey
settings.notes: Required for push since 038 (/profile shows "not configured" without the three VAPID values). Use one stable key pair per environment: rotating a live pair invalidates every existing subscription. Never sent to a client.

settings.name: Geocoding__DisabledInTests
settings.notes: true stops Nominatim calls (test hosts). Must be false or unset on DEV/PROD.

settings.name: DatabaseBackup__Enabled
settings.notes: PROD only: daily SQLite backup to the private rtub-db bucket (needs Always On). Must be false on DEV.

settings.name: DatabaseBackup__Bucket
settings.notes: PROD only: daily SQLite backup to the private rtub-db bucket (needs Always On).

settings.name: DatabaseBackup__ScheduledTime
settings.notes: UTC, HH:mm.

settings.name: DatabaseBackup__AccountId
settings.notes: PROD only: daily SQLite backup to the private rtub-db bucket (needs Always On). Falls back to Cloudflare__R2__AccountId; prefer a token scoped to the backup bucket. Never on DEV.

settings.name: DatabaseBackup__AccessKeyId
settings.notes: PROD only: daily SQLite backup to the private rtub-db bucket (needs Always On). Falls back to Cloudflare__R2__AccessKeyId; prefer a token scoped to the backup bucket. Never on DEV.

settings.name: DatabaseBackup__SecretAccessKey
settings.notes: PROD only: daily SQLite backup to the private rtub-db bucket (needs Always On). Falls back to Cloudflare__R2__SecretAccessKey; prefer a token scoped to the backup bucket. Never on DEV.
